articles.title: IAAPA Expo 2026 Sets Record with 39,000+ Attendees and 1,400 Exhibitors
articles.summary: IAAPA Expo 2026 was the largest in the event's history, drawing over 39,000 attendees and nearly 1,400 exhibiting companies across 634,000 square feet of exhibit space. The scale signals strong investment momentum and supplier confidence across the attractions industry. For FEC operators, the record turnout reflects a robust pipeline of new products, technology, and partnerships to watch heading into 2027.

articles.title: Zero Latency VR Launches Jumanji: The Lost Levels at Venues Worldwide
articles.summary: Zero Latency VR has opened bookings for Jumanji: The Lost Levels, a family-friendly free-roam VR experience available at its global venue network from December 4, 2026. The experience is the first Zero Latency title to feature fully hand-tracked gameplay, eliminating controllers and lowering the barrier for younger and casual guests. For FEC operators hosting Zero Latency installations, this major IP-backed title release is a significant driver for repeat visits and new guest acquisition.

articles.title: Triotech Unveils Five New Products at IAAPA Expo 2026 — Largest Release in Company History
articles.summary: Interactive attractions manufacturer Triotech debuted five new products at IAAPA Expo 2026, marking the biggest single product launch in the company's history. The announcement signals an accelerating pace of innovation in immersive ride and media-based attraction technology. FEC operators and suppliers should take note of Triotech's expanding portfolio as a potential differentiator for venues seeking turnkey immersive experiences.

articles.title: IAAPA Brass Ring 2026 Best Exhibit and Best New Product Award Winners Revealed
articles.summary: IAAPA announced the winners of the 2026 Brass Ring Awards for Best Exhibit and Best New Product at IAAPA Expo 2026, recognizing the industry's top innovations. These awards are among the most prestigious benchmarks for evaluating cutting-edge attraction technology and design. FEC operators can use the winners list as a shortlist for products and suppliers worth evaluating for future capital investments.

articles.title: Slick City Opens New 'Dry Waterpark' FEC in Schererville, Indiana
articles.summary: Slick City Action Park has opened a new family entertainment center in Schererville, Indiana, expanding its 'dry waterpark' concept featuring large indoor slides and active play attractions. The brand continues its rapid multi-location rollout, targeting mall and suburban markets with an accessible, all-ages format. FEC operators should watch Slick City's growth trajectory as a signal of strong consumer demand for active indoor entertainment.

articles.title: Slick City Action Park Announces New San Antonio Location
articles.summary: Slick City Action Park is expanding further with a new location planned for San Antonio, continuing the indoor slide park chain's aggressive national growth strategy. The brand's repeated site openings underscore strong investor and franchisee confidence in the active indoor entertainment segment. Competing FEC operators in Texas markets should prepare for increased competition for family leisure spend.

articles.title: ProSlide Commits $15 Million R&D Investment to Next-Generation Water Attraction Technology
articles.summary: ProSlide Technology is investing $15 million into research and development focused on water coasters, PowerRAPIDS river systems, and immersive water slide technology. The commitment signals the company's intent to lead the next wave of water attraction innovation as parks compete for experiential differentiation. For FEC operators with water park components or considering future water attractions, ProSlide's pipeline is worth tracking closely.

articles.title: Alterface Debuts Ultra-Low Latency Interactive Technology at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Alterface showcased its newest interactive shooting and gaming technology at IAAPA Expo 2026, featuring ultra-low latency of just 30 milliseconds and high-precision tracking for more responsive guest interactions. The system also gives attraction designers greater creative freedom in building interactive dark ride and shooting gallery concepts. FEC operators investing in interactive attractions should evaluate Alterface's latest platform for performance and design flexibility.

articles.title: Woozone to Exhibit Trampoline Park and Indoor Playground Equipment at IAAPA Expo Europe 2027
articles.summary: Chinese manufacturer Woozone has confirmed it will exhibit at IAAPA Expo Europe 2027 in Vienna, showcasing equipment for indoor playgrounds, trampoline parks, and related FEC attractions. The company's presence at a major European trade show signals growing global supply options for FEC operators sourcing active play equipment. Operators planning capital purchases or new builds in 2027 and 2028 should add this exhibitor to their trade show research list.

articles.title: How AI-Powered Recommendation Engines Are Transforming In-Venue Guest Apps
articles.summary: A new recommendation engine study across nine venues found that guests primarily discover attractions through queue time lists, search bars, and daily schedule feeds — but that none of these screens are personalized. The proposed engine uses real-time data to surface the single best next activity for each guest based on party composition, wait times, and preferences. FEC operators with venue apps should consider this approach to increase dwell time, reduce friction, and improve the guest experience.

articles.title: EAG360 Seminar Programme Announced with Strong Speaker Line-Up for January Show
articles.summary: EAG360, the UK's key amusement and entertainment trade event, has published its seminar programme for January, featuring industry leaders including Euromat president Jason Frost and executives from major gaming and hospitality operators. The three-day programme is integrated into the show floor experience, covering key trends shaping the coin-op, FEC, and competitive socialising sectors. FEC operators and suppliers active in the European market should consider attending for networking and strategic insight.

articles.title: Elev8 Fun Overhauling Attractions at Seminole Towne Center FEC
articles.summary: Elev8 Fun is undertaking a significant overhaul of its attractions at the Seminole Towne Center location, refreshing the guest experience at the mall-based family entertainment center. Attraction refreshes are a key strategy for FEC operators to maintain repeat visitation and compete with new entrants in the market. The move reflects a broader trend of established FECs reinvesting in their physical product to stay competitive.

articles.title: New Indoor Slide Park with 25-Foot Slides to Open in Boise Next Month
articles.summary: A new indoor park featuring 25-foot slides is set to open in Boise, Idaho, next month, adding to the growing wave of active indoor entertainment venues entering mid-sized U.S. markets. The opening reflects continued operator confidence in slide-based FEC concepts as a draw for families and young adults. FEC operators in the Pacific Northwest should monitor the new venue's performance as a local competitive indicator.

articles.title: Slick City to Open Boise Location on Milwaukee Street
articles.summary: Slick City is confirmed to open a new indoor action park in Boise, Idaho, further expanding its national footprint with another market entry. The brand's continued multi-city rollout makes it one of the fastest-growing active FEC concepts in the United States. Local operators in the Boise market and broader Pacific Northwest region should anticipate increased family entertainment competition.

articles.title: Mellors Group: How a Fourth-Generation UK Fairground Family Built a Multi-Site FEC and Theme Park Empire
articles.summary: The Mellors Group, now in its fourth generation of family ownership, has expanded from travelling showmen roots into a portfolio spanning five static UK sites including theme parks, a Manchester family entertainment centre, a London competitive socialising venue, and over 200 rides managed worldwide. Managing director James Mellors Jnr discusses the group's evolution into competitive socialising and ride manufacturing alongside traditional amusement operations. The story offers valuable lessons for FEC operators on diversification, heritage branding, and multi-format venue strategy.

articles.title: Brogent Technologies Partners with United Parks, Sony, and Toho on New Immersive Attractions
articles.summary: Flying theater and immersive attraction manufacturer Brogent has announced new partnerships with United Parks & Resorts, Grupo Iter, Toho, and Sony to develop new attractions across global markets. The deals expand Brogent's IP-backed experience portfolio and signal growing demand for licensed immersive ride content. FEC operators and park developers exploring large-format immersive attractions should follow Brogent's project pipeline for emerging IP opportunities.

articles.title: VidantaWorld's BON Theme Park Adds New Attractions with Garner Holt Animatronics and Mack Rides
articles.summary: VidantaWorld's BON luxury theme park in Mexico is adding new attractions developed in collaboration with Garner Holt Productions for animatronics and Mack Rides for ride systems. The investment underscores the growing ambition of destination resort FECs to deliver theme-park-quality immersive experiences. Operators planning anchor attractions or dark ride concepts can look to this project as a benchmark for high-end execution.

articles.title: WhiteWater's Helix Twist Wins IAAPA Brass Ring Award for Best New Product 2026
articles.summary: WhiteWater's Helix Twist, the world's first water slide with a physically twisting flume profile that creates a disorienting optical illusion for riders, won Best New Product at the 2026 IAAPA Brass Ring Awards. The slide debuted at The Land of Legends in Antalya, Turkey, and opens a new category of multi-sensory water slide design. FEC and water park operators looking for headline-generating attractions should take note of this innovation as it moves toward broader commercial availability.

articles.title: ProSlide PowerRAPIDS Wins Best New Water Ride at IAAPA Brass Ring Awards 2026
articles.summary: ProSlide's PowerRAPIDS attraction at Aquatopia Water Park in Vietnam has been named Best New Water Ride at the 2026 IAAPA Brass Ring Awards, the company's 18th first-place nomination in this category. The ride combines open-channel sliding with elevated river rapid moments and enclosed dark segments, creating a layered experience designed to maximize surprise and re-rideability. Water park operators planning future capital investments should evaluate PowerRAPIDS as a proven award-winning anchor attraction.

articles.title: UK's First Human Claw Machine Opens in Leicester, Highlighting Indoor Entertainment Growth
articles.summary: Leicester has launched the UK's first human claw machine attraction as part of a broader expansion of indoor entertainment options in the city centre. The novelty concept — where guests are lowered into a pit to grab prizes — illustrates the competitive socialising and experiential novelty trend gaining traction in UK FEC markets. Operators looking for low-footprint, high-shareability attraction concepts should monitor this format's commercial performance.

articles.title: Global AV Industry Faces 2.3 Million Professional Shortfall — A Warning for Attractions Operators
articles.summary: The global audiovisual industry faces a shortage of more than 2.3 million professionals, with women making up only 9% of the commercial AV workforce and 2% of technical roles. For attractions operators, this talent gap can delay new installations, undermine system reliability, and limit the pace of technology-driven innovation at venues. The article highlights workforce development initiatives like Rise AV as part of the longer-term solution, but FEC operators should factor AV talent availability into project timelines now.

articles.title: Four Lake Houston-Area Entertainment Venues Share Business Updates
articles.summary: Four family and group entertainment venues in the Lake Houston area have shared operational updates, offering a snapshot of how local FEC operators are managing growth, programming, and facility changes in a competitive suburban market. Community-level venue news provides useful benchmarking for operators tracking regional expansion patterns and local consumer demand signals. FEC operators in suburban Texas markets will find the updates particularly relevant.

articles.title: Madison County's 'The Gallery' Mixed-Use Development Wins TIF Approval, Includes FEC Component
articles.summary: A mixed-use development called 'The Gallery' in Madison County has received Tax Increment Financing plan approval, with a family entertainment center among its planned uses. TIF approvals for FEC-anchored mixed-use projects are a meaningful indicator of municipal confidence in the sector as an economic development driver. Developers and investors exploring public financing mechanisms for FEC projects can use this approval as a case study.

articles.title: Omaha Property at 3002 Dodge Street May Be Converted to Indoor Entertainment Venue
articles.summary: A commercial property in Omaha, Nebraska is being considered for conversion into an indoor entertainment venue, reflecting ongoing demand for experiential retail and entertainment uses in secondary markets. Adaptive reuse of retail or commercial real estate for FEC concepts has been a growing trend as vacancies create opportunity for operators. This story is a useful example of the site selection and community planning dynamics that FEC developers navigate.

articles.title: Moment Factory Opens Ancestra Lumina — First Year-Round Immersive Night Walk at a Cemetery
articles.summary: Moment Factory has launched Ancestra Lumina in Montreal, the first permanent year-round edition of its Lumina Enchanted Night Walk series, situated within a 343-acre cemetery on Mount Royal. The project demonstrates the continued commercial viability of immersive outdoor night walk experiences tied to distinctive heritage sites. FEC operators and experience designers exploring after-dark programming and immersive walk formats can study this project as a model for unique placemaking.

articles.title: HIVE Media Control Technology Powers Synchronized Projection at Hunderfossen Attraction
articles.summary: Dutch AV integrator Pro-Vision AV, working alongside BoldMove Nation, selected HIVE Media Control technology to deliver synchronized high-quality projection for a recent attraction at Hunderfossen in Norway. The project highlights the growing role of specialized media control platforms in enabling complex, multi-channel immersive experiences at family-oriented attractions. FEC operators integrating projection mapping or multi-screen media installations should evaluate HIVE as a control backbone option.

articles.title: World's First Barbie Hotel Planned in Arizona as Mattel City Concept Expands
articles.summary: Mattel is planning the world's first Barbie-branded hotel in Arizona as part of its broader Mattel City entertainment destination concept, which aims to bring multiple toy IP brands under one experiential roof. The project signals major brand owners' growing commitment to brick-and-mortar entertainment as a consumer engagement and licensing revenue channel. FEC operators and developers should monitor the Mattel City concept as an emerging competitor for family leisure spending in destination markets.

articles.title: Sacramento County Pre-Application Outlines Three Development Paths for Carmichael Site, Including Entertainment Use
articles.summary: A Sacramento County pre-application for a site in Carmichael has revealed three potential development directions, with an entertainment center among the options under consideration. The case illustrates how FEC concepts are increasingly being proposed as anchor uses in community redevelopment planning processes. Developers and operators active in California markets should track the site's progression as an example of entertainment-led mixed-use planning.
